en_US: Leo: Check me out! The excitement
of the big city has made me stronger!{VAR BE01}
Looks like I wasn't wound up enough...
I need a little more urban atmosphere.
Maybe all of this excitement is
a little too much for me...
Silvia: My glasses have locked onto you!
Let's have a Pokémon battle!{VAR BE01}
Th-there’s a crack in my glasses.
That was a smashing battle!

The time I've spent here has been
really fun and wonderful!{VAR BE01}
But, being this surrounded by excitement
makes you miss nature somehow!
All the buildings reflected in my glasses
are dazzling enough to make me dizzy!
No one's got it goin' on more than you!
You can hang out with all the tough guys!

The life of a tough guy in the city is
a little much.{VAR BE01}
White Forest is looking better
all the time.

All the racket in this city is getting
to be too much.{VAR BE01}
I want to lie on my back in the
wide-open spaces!
I have to try somethin' awful to keep up
with city life! But I still enjoy it a bit.
Aaah! I've grooved my way into a rut!
I want to take a break in White Forest!
Oh, gosh. I already lost?
Sudden endings, I'm not such a fan of!
Karenna: Faster! Faster! I'm ready
to go! Please spar with me!{VAR BE01}
Thank you very much! I still haven't
trained enough. I need to be faster!
There is a lot to learn from battles!
I want to battle more and more!

messages.en_US: Hey! You must be Unova's best!

en_US: Black City is full of hustle and bustle!
I'm sure my work will progress here!
Vincent: You don't really think you can
beat me, Black City's Ace Trainer?{VAR BE01}
An Ace Trainer like me, losing?!
This doesn't count! It just doesn't!
The awesomeness of this city
spices up my life!

I was working on my paper, but now
I've got writer's block.{VAR BE01}
Maybe getting some fresh air in
White Forest would clear my head.

In the end, everything returns
to nature, no matter what.{VAR BE01}
So that's why White Forest may
be so calming...
Black City battles really
make a person excited, huh?
Hmmm. I think I'd like
to see somewhere else soon.
Black City has so much to see.
I never get tired of it!
Black City always feels like it is
going forward. It's really cool, isn't it?

My Pokémon is saying that was
a good battle.{VAR BE01}
Don't you think my Pokémon
is truly well mannered?
Ah, you are a strong person!
I can feel it in my heart.
I've grown a little tired of looking for
my Prince Charming.

There are many strong people in this
city, so I never get bored!{VAR BE01}
I want to meet more and more
strong people!
That felt like being on the edge!
It was thrilling and fun!

Black City is great. It has culture,
and you can live comfortably.{VAR BE01}
I think when you're picking a place
to live, living comfortably is important!
Hmmm... I still have a long way to
go as a Trainer.
I want to meet more Pokémon
in my day-to-day life.
Piper: Fight efficiently and without
waste! That is my policy!{VAR BE01}
Your efficient fighting style
is truly wonderful!
Maybe there's more to life
than efficiency...

Efficiency is everything in
battling and in business.{VAR BE01}
Black City is efficient.
I like that in a place!
Miho: I'm adorable, and so is my Pokémon!
Do you think you can win against us?{VAR BE01}

messages.en_US: How can we lose when we're so cute?

en_US: Shane: You strong? I'm sure you are!
I'll check by battling with you!{VAR BE01}
I see...
I must be weak, then...
I'm a little tired of living a life where
I'm worried about how people see me.
Ralph: My feelings! I'll use a Pokémon
battle to get them through!{VAR BE01}
Did some of my excitement
get through to you?
My oh my...
I lost!
Even if I buy a lot of stuff, I'm still
unsatisfied... I have times like that!
In Black City, you can get whatever
you want! You can live securely!
My business opportunity!
It's going up in smoke!!

Business opportunities don't just come
rolling your way...{VAR BE01}
Maybe White Forest is a better fit
for me...
Ken: I've dedicated my life to Pokémon
battling. I will win as a specialist!{VAR BE01}
I apparently still haven't done enough
research on Pokémon battling.
The result is a loss.
It's a beautiful, clear answer.

messages.en_US: I managed to kill some time!

en_US: I might not know what to do with a life of
killing time every day!
Black City has lots of ways to kill time,
so I never get bored! It's great!!

messages.en_US: I lost! This city doesn't fit me well.

en_US: Just staying in one place...
I'd like to try living like that.
Wandering and having Pokémon battles!
I like living like this!
Emi: Pokémon battling...
That is the goal for my journey!{VAR BE01}
I couldn't win! But this is one of the
thrills of battling!
The combination of you and your Pokémon
was very beautiful!!
Black City
Prosperous and Vibrant
